# MD View 1.0.0-rc.1

The second public release candidate of MD View: a native Markdown, text, and code editor for
Windows, macOS, and Linux, built with Rust and egui. No webview.

## Highlights

- **No flicker at the end of split view.** Reaching the end of either pane no longer makes the
  other pane jump and snap back. A frame painted past a pane's end is discarded and repainted
  before it is shown, so no such frame ever reaches the screen.
- **Exact editor and preview synchronization.** A continuous, invertible offset map links the two
  panes. Both reach their ends on the same frame, and either pane can lead without drift.
- **Zoom keeps the panes locked.** Zoom, split resize, soft wrap, and late media re-lock the
  follower within a twentieth of a pixel, and the first frame after a zoom is already correct.
- **Typing never moves the editor.** An edit makes the editor lead, so preview re-layouts never
  scroll the text under the cursor.

Everything from 1.0.0-rc.0 is included: GitHub Markdown parity, Oniguruma highlighting, the
explorer that follows tabs, and the desktop packages.

## Install

Download the asset for your platform and verify it against `SHA256SUMS`:

| Platform | Preferred asset |
|---|---|
| Linux | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.1-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `mdview_1.0.0.rc.1_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora / RPM | `mdview-1.0.0.rc.1-1.x86_64.rpm` |
| macOS | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.1-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.1-windows-x86_64.msi` |

The macOS and Windows RC builds are **unsigned**. Gatekeeper and SmartScreen may ask for an extra
confirmation. Signing and notarization remain final 1.0.0 release-operator steps.

Documentation: https://jigonzalez930209.github.io/md-view-rs/

## Checksums and SBOM

The release includes a combined `SHA256SUMS`, `latest.json`, and `sbom.cdx.json`. Use
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` on Linux/macOS or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.

Full changelog: https://github.com/jigonzalez930209/md-view-rs/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
